sections.title: New
items: Added server support for the approved village maps in campaign battles. Campaign battles can use the scene assigned to the village when the campaign map routing is enabled.

sections.title: Fixed
items: If a generated village spawn is blocked, the server finds safe spawn positions near that side's flag. The approved flag positions stay fixed.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Corrected how the village server checks map files in Battle Lab so it can read the approved village package from its mounted folders.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed a server startup error that prevented the approved village maps from loading. Map files and reviewed flag layouts are unchanged.

sections.title: New
items: Added 77 approved village maps to the normal client download, bringing the village test selection to 82 maps. Four rejected villages are left out.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Admins can choose from the full approved village selection in Change Map. Village names appear in the map picker and battle interface.
New village layouts keep the reviewed flag positions at least 250 metres apart. Each switch keeps the attacker roster, AI defenders and 15-second warmup.
The new villages are ready for in-game review once this release is delivered.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed the missing Change Map option for admins in village siege rehearsals.

sections.title: New
items: Admins in private village siege rehearsals can switch maps from the Escape menu. Each map keeps the attacker roster, has AI defenders, and starts with a 15-second warmup.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Barricades use Bannerlord's wooden siege barricade. Barricades and stakes have 200 HP and show the standard health bar when targeted after taking damage.
Carry up to four Barricade or Stakes Kits in any mix. Each side can have up to 15 barricades and 15 stake barriers standing at once.
Teammates can damage and destroy their side's deployables.
